content.text:

content.text:
We might not. But if there are two scenarios where I'm seeing IDP coming into play. If the API is returning a PDF to be downloaded, we will need IDP if the API is returning JSON data, we will not need IDP if the SFTP files are all in Excel, we can directly use the platform if the standard...
If the format is standard, then we can use the platform directly. If the emails are getting Excel in a standard format again, we can use Platform if the formats are different and then probably we'll need IDP...

content.text: Okay, that makes a lot of sense. Okay, would it be possible if you ghost strip me those questions to ask...?

content.speaker: Speaker 4
content.text: Maybe we can send dust and those questions ahead of our call today just so we can iron that out?

content.speaker: kailash chanda
content.text: Sure. Thank you. Thanks a lot.
